hohlmike4: Isidor Hohlmike stepped off the supply cart at R-F3 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Isidor Hohlmike helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
j_ak_u_b1: On the way to S-S9, Felix Jakub tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
kirov_34: On Day 5, Oskar Kirov arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
